prompts.name: Russell Wilson
prompts.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create a production photo atlas for a hidden-person fan game. EXACT 3 columns x 2 rows of equal photographs, clean straight borders, no margins, labels or text. A wide 3:2 overall canvas, six equal square cells. The FIRST FIVE cells are realistic fictional candid crowd photos, each containing ONE naturally integrated Russell Wilson, recognizable as during Seattle Seahawks · 2016–2021, ordinary size among 30–45 diverse people, no huge face or floating pasted head. Match lighting, perspective and focus of surrounding people, with lower body hidden by foreground crowd. The same face and hairstyle throughout. His face must remain visible; no hat or sunglasses. Plain navy and lime green casual jacket, no letters. Top left: busy farmers market, his head near cell x.28 y.40. Top middle: bustling train concourse, head near x.68 y.40. Top right: stadium tailgate, head near x.42 y.60. Bottom left: crowded outdoor street food fair, head near x.75 y.35. Bottom middle: stadium arrival queue, head near x.57 y.48. Bottom right: matching clear face-reference portrait of Russell Wilson, same age/hair and navy and lime green jacket, neutral background. No other crowd member duplicates his face. Different natural crowded situation in each photograph. No circles, arrows or markers. Faithful equal 3x2 grid, no uneven collage. All first five scenes include him naturally and allow finding his face by matching the sixth image.
